cards.answer: Hecarim is a mobile fighter/tank who charges into enemies and repeatedly cleaves nearby targets. His bonus movement speed grants attack damage; his cleave deals physical damage, while his aura and spectral riders deal magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance during his charge and spread out to reduce his opportunities for grouped cleaves and fear.

cards.answer: Devastating Charge builds movement speed and lets Hecarim move through units. His next attack gains range and makes him dash toward the target, dealing physical damage, knocking them back and briefly stunning them. Traveling farther strengthens the damage and knockback.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance and avoid letting him approach from behind you toward his team.

cards.answer: Onslaught of Shadows sends Hecarim dashing with displacement immunity while spectral riders deal magic damage along their path. At his destination, he fears and slows nearby enemies; a longer dash causes a longer fear.
cards.counterplay: Spread out and move away from his destination; avoid relying on knockbacks to stop the dash.
